rows.text: Zeroes the qword at `rcx`, takes an object from the pool at `02EAD5B0` through `007DF750` and returns -1 when it is null; otherwise it obtains a 16-bit id from `007B5580` on `02EAD600` with that object, increments the counter dword at `02EAD5A4` and writes the handle at `rcx` (byte 3, the id as word `+2`, the counter as dword `+4`), constructs the object with `007E6960` and calls `007E71F0` on its result with stack copies of the handle and of the qword at `[rdx]` and a stack record holding `01CB4D58` and the qword at `r8+8`, returning that call's result; both paths store `01CB4D48` to `[r8]` before returning.

Walks the node list headed at `02EAD6B0`, returning 0 at once when it is empty: for each node it calls `007E8BB0` on the node's object (`+0x20`) with `xmm1` = the incoming `xmm0`, and when the object's dword `+0x1E8` is not 5 it stops (returns 0) if bit `0x1` of the node's dword `+0x1C` is clear, else moves to the node's `+0x10` successor; when it is 5 it calls the object's vtable slot `+8` (decrementing the dword at `02EAD63C` when that returns 1), and if the node's signed dword `+0x18` indexes an entry below the count `02EAD698` of the 0x28-byte table whose pointer is the qword at `02EAD6A0` whose bit `0x1` of `+0x1C` is set, unlinks that entry from the list (head `02EAD6B0`, tail `02EAD6B8`), clears the bit, pushes it on the list at `02EAD6A8`, decrements `02EAD69C` and moves to the saved successor (otherwise it stays on the same node); it then calls the object's vtable slot `+0` with `edx`=0 and returns the object to `02EAD640` through `007DF8D0`; the walk returns 0 when the next node is null, with the stack cookie checked through `00808C40`.

Fills the object at `rcx` without calls and returns it in `rax`: pointers `01CB5A30`, `01CB5B98` and `01CB5BA8` at `+0`, `+8`, `+0x10` and `01CB43E0` at `+0x28`, the other qwords `+0x18` to `+0x58` and word `+0x60` zeroed; four 0x40-byte slots from `+0x88` headed by `01CB5A20` with `01CB4890` at slot `+0x30`, qword `+0x38` zero and five fields cleared (qwords `+8`/`+0x10`, dwords `+0x1C`/`+0x24`, byte `+0x20`); thirteen 0x30-byte slots headed by `01CB44A0` (at `+0x188`, three from `+0x1B8`, two from `+0x248`, `+0x2A8`, `+0x2D8`, four from `+0x308` and `+0x3C8`) with the same five fields cleared; the four 0x40-byte entries from `+0x400` zeroed twice and the qwords `+0x500` to `+0x530` zeroed except dword `+0x520` = -1; then dword `+8` = 0, float `+0xC` = 1.0, dwords `+0x10`/`+0x14` = 0 and `+0x1C`/`+0x20`/`+0x24` cleared again in the slots at `+0x88`, `+0x108`, `+0x148`, `+0x188`, `+0x1E8`, `+0x2A8`, `+0x2D8`, `+0x308`, `+0x338`, `+0x368` and `+0x398`, and the five fields cleared again at `+0xC8`, `+0x1B8`, `+0x218`, `+0x248` and `+0x278`; the floats `+0x64` to `+0x7C` set to 1.0, bytes `+0x80` to `+0x83` set to 0xFE and byte `+0x3F8` cleared.

Zeroes the floats at `[rdx]`, `[r8]` and `[r9]`, then for the parameter blocks at `rcx+0x1C0`, `+0x1F0` and `+0x220` adds to them respectively the block's float `+4` when its float `+0xC` compares equal to 0 or unordered, else the block's float `+0` plus (`+4` minus `+0`) times the result of `007A9E50` called with float `+8` divided by `+0xC` and dword `+0x14`; it then wraps `[rdx]` by adding 2 while it is below -1 (`01CEBC9C`, unordered also looping) and adding -2 (`008F3148`) while it is above 1 (`01CEBBA8`), clamps `[r8]` and `[r9]` to -1 when not at least -1 (unordered included) and otherwise to at most 1 (`minss`), and returns 0 in `eax`.

Starts from 0 when the object's vtable slot `+0x130` returns non-zero `al`, else from the float at `+0xC` of the object at `rcx+0x30`, multiplies it by one factor from each of the four 0x40-byte slots at `rcx+0x88` and finally by the float at `rcx+0x64`, returning the product in `xmm0`; a slot's factor is its float `+0xC` when its float `+0x14` compares equal to 0 or unordered, otherwise, with ratio = `+0x10` / `+0x14`: when its qword `+0x38` is null, `+8` + (`+0xC` - `+8`) times `007A9E50` of the ratio and dword `+0x1C`; when it is set, `007AE260` on the slot's `+0x30` record with 1 minus the ratio gives `+0xC` + (`+8` - `+0xC`) times the result if float `+8` is above `+0xC`, or with the ratio gives `+8` + (`+0xC` - `+8`) times the result otherwise (unordered included).

When the float `xmm1` is below 0 or unordered (`comiss`/`jb`) or above 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`), it formats `01CB5CD8` with it as a double through `0019C5D0` into a 256-byte stack buffer with a newline (calling `00809728` if the terminator index reaches 0x100), passes the buffer to the import at `008C2120` and to `007A5570` with 1 and returns -1; otherwise it calls `007CA560` on `rcx+0x2A8` with the incoming `rdx`, `r8` and `xmm1`, `r9`=0 and a zero byte argument and returns its result, both returns checking the stack cookie through `00808C40`.

Returns 0 at once when the object's vtable slot `+0x130` returns zero `al` and byte `+0x19` of the object at `rcx+0x30` has bit `0x1` or `0x8` set; otherwise it handles three values, each accepted only within -1 (`01CEBC9C`) to 1 (`01CEBBA8`), below or unordered and above both rejected: for `xmm1` it reads the current value with `007A9E00` on `rcx+0x1B8`, wraps that value into -1..1 by steps of 2, wraps the target minus the wrapped value the same way, and calls `007CA560` on `rcx+0x1B8` with the unwrapped current value plus that difference; `xmm2` and `xmm3` go directly to `007CA560` on `rcx+0x1E8` and `rcx+0x218`; each call also gets the fifth (float) argument in `xmm2`, `r9`=0 and a zero byte, and each rejected value is formatted as a double with `01CB5C30`, `01CB5C68` or `01CB5CA0` through `0019C5D0` and logged through the import at `008C2120` and `007A5570` with 1; it then returns 0, checking the stack cookie through `00808C40`.

Enters the lock at `rcx+0x10` through the import at `008C20B8` and, unless the dword at `rcx+0x68` is 4, looks up a stack copy of the qword at `rcx+0x40` with `007B2470` and calls the result's vtable slot `+8`; when that returns 2 and byte `+5` of the object at `rcx+0x58` is 1 or 2 (byte minus 1 not above 1, unsigned), it calls `007E2EB0` with the looked-up object and `rcx-8` and then `007E4860` on that result with `edx`; it then calls `007EAA60` with `rcx-8` and, when byte `+0x124` is 1, calls vtable slot `+0x10` of the object at `+0x60` and sets `+0x68` to 4 when that result is not greater than zero (signed `jg`); every path ends by tail-jumping to the import at `008C20C0` with `rcx+0x10`.

Returns at once when byte `rcx+0x68` is zero; otherwise, when byte `+0x28` is set it adds `xmm1` to float `+0x18` and, once the sum is at least float `+0x1C`, stores `+0x1C` there and clears the byte (a sum below it or unordered sets the byte to 1), does the same for float `+0x48` against `+0x4C` under byte `+0x58`, then takes a rate equal to float `+0x44` when `+0x4C` compares equal to 0 or unordered, else `+0x40` + (`+0x44` - `+0x40`) times `007A9E50` of `+0x48` / `+0x4C` and dword `+0x54`, adds 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) divided by that rate times `xmm1` to float `+0`, and when the result is at least 1.0 subtracts its truncated integer part, returning with no result value.

corrections.why: byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: The 0x28-byte table is not at `02EAD6A0`: its base is loaded from the qword at `02EAD6A0` (`007B5B60 mov rax, qword ptr [rip+...]`).

byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: The 'most then given dword `+8` = 0, float `+0xC` = 1.0 ...' clause is attributed only to the 0x30-byte slots, but the same writes also go to three of the four 0x40-byte slots (`+0x88` via `007BCB95`, `+0x108`, `+0x148`), while the slot at `+0xC8` and the 0x30-byte slots at `+0x1B8`, `+0x218`, `+0x248`, `+0x278` and `+0x3C8` only get their five fields cleared (again for all but `+0x3C8`); 'most' does not say which.; The 0x40-byte slots' cleared fields (qwords `+8`/`+0x10`, dwords `+0x1C`/`+0x24`, byte `+0x20`, qword `+0x38`) are not stated.
